clips.title: The story
paras: Eastvale Logging Camp is a vital lumber settlement tucked into the eastern woodlands of Elwynn Forest, near the border with the Redridge Mountains. The camp supplies vital timber to Stormwind and surrounding settlements, but its operations are constantly hampered by hungry predators prowling the surrounding forests.

Orders for timber constantly stream into Eastvale Logging Camp from buyers across the Kingdom of Stormwind, but meeting these strict deadlines is a harrowing task. The dense wilderness surrounding the camp swarms with vicious wolves and prowling bears that routinely chase lumberjacks away from their worksites, leaving valuable cut timber abandoned in the woods. Under the direction of Supervisor Raelen, the camp frequently relies on wandering adventurers to cull the encroaching beasts and retrieve fallen wood before deliveries fall fatally behind schedule.
